name: Miko-san Hosoude Hanjouki
source:
Main character receives priest education and returns from Tokyo to his home town. But the local shrine is on the verge of bankruptcy. Protagonist needs to work hard alongside cute shrine maidens and childhood friends. Who will be his girlfriend during the festival?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角受完神職訓練後，從東京回到故鄉。然而，當地神社已瀕臨破產。主角必須與可愛的巫女和青梅竹馬一起努力工作。祭典期間，誰會成為他的女朋友？

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
